description: Erection of a part single part two storey side and rear extension with one front roof roof window to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( 2009/3-LP Rev. J; 2009/3-03 Rev. J; 2009/3-04 Rev. J; 2009/3-05 Rev. J; 2009/3-06 Rev. J; 2009/3-07 Rev. J; 2009/3-08 Rev. J; 2009/3-09 Rev. J; 2009/3-10 Rev. J; 2009/3-11 Rev. J; 2009/3-12 Rev. J (received on 21 May 2019) ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
